summary.text: Jennifer Clancy is the Democratic nominee for the Maryland House of Delegates, District 29A, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Matt Morgan (R).
A mental health counselor and former educator, she lists education, healthcare and community as her priorities in a Ballotpedia survey.

paragraphs.text: Jennifer Clancy earned a high school diploma from Pennsauken High School and a graduate degree from Rowan University in 2008, and her career experience includes working as a mental health counselor.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a former educator, licensed professional counselor, homesteader and mother of five, and the wife of a law enforcement officer.
Clancy was unopposed in the June 23, 2026 Democratic primary.
Her stated campaign messages are fully funding public education and libraries, accessible and affordable healthcare, and supporting local agriculture, aquaculture and agritourism.
She also named fair tax contributions and the protection of constitutional rights as areas of policy interest.
